requirements.requirement: node1 has the persistent system hostname os-lab.infra.test
requirements.summary: The runtime and persistent hostname matched the requested value before restart and again after a verified boot-ID change, directly demonstrating persistence across reboot.
The local hosts entry maps the requested name to 127.0.1.1, and getent successfully resolved it before and after reboot.

overall_summary: Both task outcomes are satisfied with direct pre- and post-restart evidence. The restart protocol includes a healthy pre-state, acknowledgement, independently corroborated boot-ID change, and recovered hostname, resolver, SSH, and network state. Hygiene is strong aside from one retained temporary reboot log.
limitations: The lifecycle collector could not perform its systemd failed-unit check on Alpine, and no equivalent comprehensive OpenRC service-health inventory was captured; recovered access and listening sockets nevertheless provide supporting recovery evidence.

operational_hygiene.summary: The hostname and hosts-file mutations were necessary, and the reboot supported the mandatory restart protocol. The repeated unsuccessful commands during reboot were read-only availability probes and caused no demonstrated mutation. One minor residue remained: cmd-19948d2987b94210 created /tmp/antrieb-reboot.log for the restart, but it was not removed. No new listening service, package damage, or other unnecessary mutation was observed.
